entry.title: 🧑‍🎓 We are **recruiting** undergraduate students for 2026 Summer Internship!

link.title: 🧑‍🎓 We are **recruiting** undergraduate students for 2026 Summer Internship!

entry.content:
Application

  • Undergraduate transcript, Cover letter (1 page including motivation), CV (optional)
  • Application Form: Fill this google form! Link

Lab Introduction

SEOULTECH IXLAB conducts cutting-edge research in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). Our mission is to contribute to top-tier international conferences and journals while shaping the future of how humans interact with technology.

1. Immersive Spatial Computing

  • User behavior/performance modeling
    • [CHI ‘26] Steering through a dynamically varying path [DOI]
    • [CHI ‘26] How Video See-Through MR Affects Pointing on Physical Devices: From Smartphones to Large Monitors [DOI]
    • [CHI ‘26] Investigating the Impact of Lying Postures on Mixed Reality Interaction [DOI]
    • [CHI ‘25] Understanding User Behavior in Window Selection using Dragging for Multiple Targets [DOI]
    • [IJHCI ‘26] Effect of Onset Position of Ray Casting in Virtual Reality [DOI]
  • Interactive MR/AR/VR applications
    • [CHI ‘26] Exploring Interface Design of MR Translation System for Everyday Interaction [DOI]
    • [CHI ‘25] Through the Looking Glass, and What We Found There: A Comprehensive Study of User Experiences with Pass-Through Devices in Everyday Activities [DOI]
    • [ISMAR ‘25] Exploring Interface Design of Translation System for Enhanced Immersion and Usability in Mixed Reality [DOI]
    • [IUI ‘25] A picture is worth a thousand words? Investigating the Impact of Image Aids in AR on Memory Recall for Everyday Tasks [DOI]

2. Intelligence-Augmented & Generative Interaction

  • Generative AI for Audio-Visual Interaction
    • [IJHCS ‘26] SnapSound: Empowering everyone to customize sound experience with Generative AI [DOI]
    • [PeerJ CS ‘24] Mitigating Inappropriate Concepts in Text-to-Image Generation with Attention-guided Image Editing [DOI]
    • [CHI ‘23] Tingle Just for You: A Preliminary Study of AI-based Customized ASMR Content Generation [DOI]
  • LLMs-based Human-centered Interaction
    • [CHI ‘26] Knight Path: Supporting Player Sense-making in Game Narratives via Visual Scaffolding and Spoiler-Aware AI [DOI]
    • [ISMAR ‘24] Public Speaking Q&A Practice with LLM-Generated Personas in Virtual Reality [DOI]
    • [SIGGRAPH Asia ‘24] Designing LLM Response Layouts for XR Workspaces in Vehicles [DOI]

3. Multimodal Sensing Interfaces (Gaze, Speech, Gestures)

  • [UIST ‘25] Silent Yet Expressive: Toward Seamless VR Communication through Emotion-aware Silent Speech Interfaces [DOI]
  • [CHI ‘25] Exploring Emotion Expression Through Silent Speech Interface in Public VR/MR [DOI]
  • [EAIT ‘25] Enhancing Learner Experience with Instructor Cues in Video Lectures: A Comprehensive Exploration and Design Discovery toward A Novel Gaze Visualization [DOI]
  • [IJHCI ‘24] EchoTap: Non-verbal Sound Interaction with Knock and Tap Gestures [DOI]
  • [ICMI ‘21] Knock & Tap: Classification and Localization of Knock and Tap Gestures using Deep Sound Transfer Learning [DOI]

4. Human-Agent Interaction (New 2026 NRF Project)

  • We received a 5-year research grant from NRF in 2026, in which we will develop a novel interaction framework for Human-Agent Interaction.
  • Human AI interaction is rapidly evolving from LLM-based applications to Agent-based ecosystems.
  • We explore how human and agents can collaborate to create a better future.
  • Main research topics include:
    • Design of Tangible Agent interfaces and interaction
    • Embodied Human-Agent Interaction
    • Enhancing UI/UX of Human-Agent Interaction for Web, Mobile, XR environments
    • Multi-User Multi-Agent Interaction
    • … and your ideas!

Internship Duration

  • 2026.06.29 ~ 2026.08.31
  • Extension will be considered based on how well the student suits our Lab.

Target Candidates

  • Students eager to conduct research integrating Human-Computer Interaction with AI/AX technologies.
  • Students with a strong interest in at least one of our core research areas listed above.
  • Students considering enrollment in Graduate programs.
    • 4th-year students: Only students who are considering applying for the Master or Integrated Master-Ph.D program for Spring 2027 are eligible for selection.

Qualifications

  • Attitude: Self-motivated, sincere, and a proactive team player
  • Commitment: No planned long-term absences (e.g., exchange programs) during the internship
  • Participation: Active involvement in lab activities during weekdays (semester and vacation)
  • Activities: Able to attend domestic conferences, workshops, and seminars
  • Skills: Basic programming sense

Requirements & Benefits

  • Research Growth: Students will have deeper understanding of HCI and UI/UX fundamentals, VR/AR technologies, AI Agent ecosystem, Mobile/Web platforms, ML/DL applications, etc.
  • Research Autonomy: Although our lab shares a common research theme, students are encouraged to propose and lead their own research projects based on their unique interests within the HCI field.
  • Individualized Mentorship: Students will receive direct guidance from Professor Jin-Woo Jeong to help navigate academic growth and research direction.
  • Work hours
    • Master/Ph.D students: at least 40 hours/week
    • Undergraduate students: flexible (Semester), at least 35 hours/week (Vacation)
  • International Conference Travel Support
    • Master/Ph.D students: at least 1 conference/year
    • Undergraduate students: if the authored paper is accepted
  • Stipend
    • Master students: at least 2,000,000 KRW/month + Tuition fee (미래인재장학금)
    • Ph.D students: at least 3,000,000 KRW/month + Tuition fee (미래인재장학금)
    • Undergraduate students: at least 700,000 KRW/month (July/August), 1,000,000 KRW/month + BEAR scholarship (for students committed to entering graduate school)
  • Equipments: Personal office space and individual PC/dual monitors setup
  • Various research-purpose devices are provided (VR/MR HMDs, Eyetrackers, Sensors, Wearable devices, etc.)

Timeline

  • Application Deadline: 2026.05.29 (Fri)
  • Interviewee Notification: 2026.06.01 (Mon)
  • Interview: 2026.06.04 (Thu) ~ 2026.06.09 (Tue)
  • Result Announcement: 2026.06.12 (Fri)
  • Internship Period: 2026.06.29 (Mon) ~ 2026.08.31 (Mon)

Application

  • Undergraduate transcript, Cover letter (1 page including motivation), CV (optional)
  • Application Form: Fill this google form! Link

Contact

  • Email: jinw.jeong@seoultech.ac.kr (Jin-Woo Jeong, PI)

entry.title: 📄 Four posters **accepted** to **ACM** **CHI** 2026!
entry.content:
Our papers were accepted to ACM CHI 2026 as Posters!

  • “Investigating the Impact of Lying Postures on Mixed Reality Interaction” by Yujin Jeong, Jiwon Lee, Jae-Yeop Jeong, Euna Byun, HyeokJu Ko

  • “How Video See-Through MR Affects Pointing on Physical Devices: From Smartphones to Large Monitors” by Yujin Jeong, Jae-Yeop Jeong, HyeokJu Ko

  • “Knight Path: Supporting Player Sense-making in Game Narratives via Visual Scaffolding and Spoiler-Aware AI” by Euna Byun, Jae-Yeop Jeong, Yewon Min

  • “Reading the Mood Behind Words: Integrating Prosody-Derived Emotional Context into Socially Responsive VR Agents” Cowork with SangYeop Jeong, YeongSeo Na, Seung Gyu Jeong, Seoung-Eun Kim

Congratulations to all authors!
entry.summary: Four posters accepted to ACM CHI 2026!
